t: 英国国王理查一世授予朴茨茅斯第一份皇家特许状。
te: King Richard I of England gives Portsmouth its first royal charter.
dz: 英国国王理查一世授予朴茨茅斯第一份皇家特许状。
de: King Richard I of England gives Portsmouth its first royal charter.

dz: 叙利亚人迈克尔对摩尔·巴尔·萨乌马修道院进行再造,他在被大火摧毁后重建了该修道院. 该修道院一直作为叙利亚正教会的中心,直到13世纪末.
de: Michael the Syrian reconsecrates the Mor Bar Sauma Monastery, which he reconstructed after its destruction by a fire. The monastery stays a center of the Syriac Orthodox Church until the end of the thirteenth century.

t: 斯韦尔被加冕为挪威国王,导致他被天主教会和内战的驱使.
te: Sverre is crowned King of Norway, leading to his excommunication by the Catholic Church and civil war.
dz: 斯韦尔被加冕为挪威国王,导致他被天主教会和内战的驱使.
de: Sverre is crowned King of Norway, leading to his excommunication by the Catholic Church and civil war.

t: 巴勒莫被神圣罗马皇帝亨利六世所征服.
te: Palermo is conquered by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 巴勒莫被神圣罗马皇帝亨利六世所征服.
de: Palermo is conquered by Henry VI, Holy Roman Emperor.
